title: 英文第18題｜who 作主詞的間接問句
question:
Tell me _____.

(A) who will be with you
(B) what is he going to do
(C) why did he cry so sadly yesterday
(D) how long has your sister been a teacher
explanation:
A 的 who 詢問跟你在一起的是誰，本身就是 will be 的主詞。Tell me who will be with you 直接接上 who、will be 和 with you。其餘各選項已有自己的主詞，應將主詞放在助動詞或 be 前。

(A) who 本身是主詞，後面接 will be，語序完整。
(B) he 是主詞，應寫 what he is going to do。
(C) he 是主詞，間接問句保留過去式，應寫 why he cried so sadly yesterday。
(D) your sister 是主詞，應寫 how long your sister has been a teacher。
subject: English
trap: 先判斷是問「誰是主詞」，還是問時間、原因等其他資訊。who 作主詞時後接 will be。
